bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money for a student attendance marketing campaign.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ATTENDANCE MARKETING CAMPAIGN.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated.

Subd. 2.

Student attendance marketing campaign.

(a) To contract for a student attendance marketing campaign:

$

250,000

.....

2026

$

0

.....

2027

(b) The department must issue a request for proposals to develop and execute a three-year student attendance marketing campaign to raise awareness of the importance of student attendance and the consequences of absenteeism. The campaign must include information to help families overcome barriers to attendance and must be inclusive of all public school students.

(c) The department must award a contract to an organization that demonstrates capacity to reach wide and varied audiences of students and their families. The department may accept more than one proposal to develop and execute a marketing campaign. A proposal for a marketing campaign must include goals, planned statewide and targeted strategies, and a plan to objectively evaluate the impact of the campaign.

(d) Upon conclusion of the campaign, an organization that was awarded a contract must report to the department the goals of the campaign, strategies implemented, data demonstrating the outcomes, and how the money was used.

(e) The department may use no more than three percent of the appropriation to administer the request for proposals and contract under this subdivision.

(f) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.
